Name: New Mx. Qi
Author: orngjce223
Description:
Isi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4310]Mx. Qi[/url] has not been updated since 1.4, meaning that the 1.5 and 1.6 content was never added. So, here it is.

From the original description:
[quote]Gender binary got you down? Now you can eschew that silly gendered prefix in Mr. Qi's name by making him Mx. Qi! It may not roll off the tongue as well, but who says mysterious casino owners need to follow the gender binary?[/quote]

[b]Limitations[/b]: There are two things that I could not modify in Content Patcher due to them being hard-coded rather than in any of the strings files (includes 1.6 spoiler):
[spoiler][list]
[*]The secret cutscene in 1.6 for clipping out of bounds is hard-coded to come from one "Mister Qi". This is uniquely odd since everywhere else in the game, he's "Mr. Qi" (or the translation thereof).
[*]Likewise, the easter egg where you input Qi's name into the chatbox has hardcoded responses.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[b]To install[/b]:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by unzipping it and putting it in SMAPI's Mods folder.
[*][b]WARNING: MAKE SURE YOU DO NOT ALSO HAVE THE ORIGINAL MX. QI INSTALLED.[/b] They overwrite the same file, and the resulting effects might be unpredictable.
[*]Install this mod by unzipping it and also putting it in SMAPI's Mods folder.
[/list]
[b]Other languages[/b]: Not included, since I don't actually know how grammatical gender-bending works in other languages, but if you want to make your own, go wild - just credit both me and Isi.

[b]Multiplayer compatibility[/b]: It should be fine to use this in multiplayer, but nobody else will see it.

I reserve the right to delete any harassment or hate.

Downloads.Description: Make sure you remove the original "Mx. Qi" mod before installing this one!
